decision.rationale: TXN-008096 is on card CRD-000238. It is a charge of 128115 minor units (1281.15 EUR) at MER-000033 (ASHGROVE APPAREL), posted on 2026-06-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 141 days after posting. Policy section time-limits says a dispute must be opened within 120 days of posting, and a later dispute is declined even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. The authorisation AUTH-008287 would otherwise point to an unauthorised payment: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and fraud flag set. However, the time limit is applied first and decides the case. The card has no other transactions at this merchant: TXN-008096 is the only one.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 141 days after the transaction posted on 2026-06-10. The limit for opening a dispute is 120 days from posting, and it applies even when a transaction carries fraud indicators.
